title: Drop wakes whose cause has already changed

source.text: 23% of agent reports in the 7 days to 2026-10-24 are about wakes and dispatch; two wake fixes did not hold.

change: Before delivering a wake, check the state it was sent for (PR head, brief revision, step already reported) and drop it if that state changed.

metric.label: Share of reports about wakes and dispatch

guardrail: Corners left with no next step for more than 24 hours do not rise above the week before.
